title: Beef and Padrón Pepper Quinoa Bowl
blurb: A quick one-pan meal where ground beef and blistered Padrón peppers meet fluffy quinoa, with grated carrot for sweetness and fresh basil stirred through at the end.
steps: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve, then tip into a small saucepan with the water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender.

While the quinoa cooks, heat half the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Add the whole Padrón peppers and fry for 4 to 5 minutes, turning occasionally, until blistered and softened. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil to the same pan and crumble in the beef. Cook over high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned.
Peel and coarsely grate the carrot, then peel and finely chop the garlic. Add both to the beef and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often.
Stir the soy sauce into the beef mixture, then add the cooked quinoa and the blistered peppers. Toss everything together for a minute to combine.
Tear the basil leaves and scatter over the top just before serving.
